biotools.summary: FA-NIVA is an automated Nextflow workflow designed for the comprehensive detection and analysis of structural and single nucleotide variants (SNVs) from Nanopore-based long-read sequencing data, specifically tailored for genetic analysis of Fanconi anemia.
